title: Characterize object list 800363F4

behavior.role: move a caller-confirmed non-head list entry to the owner head

arguments.a0: owner object; 32-bit head pointer is loaded from +0x74 with lw
arguments.a1: target entry; 32-bit next pointer is loaded/stored at +0x74 with lw/sw

behavior.null_paths: null owner or target entry returns zero without mutation
behavior.search: starts at owner.head and follows +0x74 links until current equals target; caller establishes target membership before call
behavior.mutation_order: previous->next = target->next; target->next = owner.head; owner->head = target; return 1

caller.name: func_8001904C_19C4C
caller.call_contract: checks the head separately, scans from head->next until a match or null, calls the target only for a found non-head entry, and saves that entry across the call
caller.search_key: caller compares the field at +0x2C using masks 0x8FFFFFFF and 0x8FFFFFFE
caller.return_use: the helper return is not used on the move path

behavior.callbacks: none in the target; it performs no calls
behavior.unknowns: a non-null target absent from the list is outside the caller-established precondition and is not a safe test case

host_model.negative_control: not rerun for G64-076; G64-075 already demonstrated rejection of a broken predecessor relink for the same reference contract
host_model.limitations: the added harness is a reference model, not production C for 800363F4 and not a test of invalid pointers or live engine state
